milestone.title: Status-transition guards: runner reliably reaches self-reviewed, coordinator reliably reaches complete

intent.outcome: The lifecycle transitions documented in mp-runner (stage 7 → self-reviewed) and mp-coordinator (stage 10 clean → advance to complete) happen reliably and visibly. raul shows the correct status because the agent does not silently skip the transition. The fix is investigation-driven: confirm whether the gap is (a) the agent skipping a documented step, or (b) a missing single primitive for the final transition, then apply the minimal fix — sharper skill instruction, a plan_gaps/validate warning, or a unified transition command.

problem.description: Observers see milestones stuck in the wrong lifecycle state (e.g., all steps done but still 'in-progress' instead of 'self-reviewed'; findings remediated but still 'remediation' instead of 'complete'). The skills DO document the transitions — mp-runner lines 72-93 cover the complete→self-reviewed transition via mp milestone complete --evidence, and mp-coordinator line 70-71 covers re-review clean → advance to Document. So the gap is not a missing instruction; it is that agents do not reliably execute the step. Root cause unconfirmed: it may be skill-text sharpness, a missing validation nudge, or friction in the transition primitive itself. This milestone investigates first, then applies the minimal fix.

in_scope: Investigation: reproduce the stuck-state on a recently-completed milestone. Check whether mp execution status / mp validate / plan_gaps already surfaces a 'steps done but not self-reviewed' or 'findings resolved but not complete' warning. Determine which of (a) skill-text sharpness, (b) missing validation nudge, (c) missing unified primitive is the real cause.
Fix path (a) — skill-text: if the agent skips the transition, sharpen mp-runner and mp-coordinator to make the transition a mandatory, numbered step with the exact command, not prose.

Fix path (b) — validation nudge: if no warning exists, add a plan_gaps/validate rule that flags lifecycle states inconsistent with step/finding state (all steps done but lifecycle != self-reviewed; all findings resolved but lifecycle still remediation). Non-blocking warning, reported in raul.

Fix path (c) — unified primitive: if the final re-review→complete transition requires multiple commands and agents drop one, add a single primitive (e.g., mp reviews pass --verdict approved advancing lifecycle to complete in one step) and document it.
raul: if a validation nudge is added, ensure the warning surfaces in the milestones lane so humans see the stuck state, not just agents.
out_of_scope: No new lifecycle states or changes to the state machine (M100's 9 states are final). This milestone only makes existing transitions reliable.
No automation config (that is M147). This milestone does not add commit/push/branch knobs; it fixes the transition reliability itself.
No skill catalog changes (that is M146).
Does not add auto-remediation of findings — only the lifecycle transition after findings are resolved.

design_decisions.rationale: The transitions are already documented in the skills. Assuming the fix (skill tweak vs validation rule vs new command) before reproducing the stuck-state risks solving the wrong layer. Confirming root cause first keeps this a small, targeted milestone.
Lifecycle transitions should be visible when missed, not block other work. A warning that surfaces in raul and validate is the right pressure — it informs without forcing.

design_decisions.choice: confirm root cause before coding; apply the minimal of three fix paths (a/b/c), not all
design_decisions.rationale: The skills already document the transitions, so the gap is behavioral, not missing. Building all three fixes would be speculative; the investigation pins which lever (text/nudge/primitive) actually moves the agent, then we pull only that one.

design_decisions.choice: M100's 9 lifecycle states are final; this milestone only makes existing transitions reliable
design_decisions.rationale: Adding states would ripple through mp-flow, raul, and every skill. The stuck-state symptom is a transition-execution gap, not a modeling gap — fixing the execution preserves the model.

design_decisions.choice: this milestone is a hard prerequisite for M149's lifecycle-polling completion gate
design_decisions.rationale: M149 (post B1 challenge) uses plan.json lifecycle as the sole reliable completion signal. If the transitions this milestone fixes are unreliable, mp watch hangs or mis-detects completion on the exact stuck-states here. M149 now depends_on M148.

design_decisions.choice: Do not hard-depend on M145; investigate first. If root cause is the done→complete ceremony gap, prefer M145 landing and shrink this milestone to residual self-reviewed stuck-states only.
design_decisions.rationale: M145 (grooming) auto-promotes lifecycle=done→complete on reviews pass; M148 targets self-reviewed and complete transitions. Overlap is real but M145 is not ready — a hard dep would idle an execution-ready investigation milestone.

steps.evidence:
ROOT CAUSE (2026-07-12 investigation):

PRIMARY: (c) docs/code mismatch + fractional stage-10 primitive
- Skills claim `mp milestone complete` → lifecycle=self-reviewed (templates/skills/mp-runner/SKILL.md:92-93)
- Code sets lifecycle=complete (crates/mp/src/milestone/complete.rs:352)
- Model ER-3: self-reviewed/reviewed owned by reviews registry, but no happy-path writer sets them
- Stage 10 staged command is only `mp milestone verify` (no lifecycle write); skills omit `mp reviews pass --verdict ok`
- Dogfood: 144 complete, 0 self-reviewed, 0 reviewed — middle rungs unused

SECONDARY: (b) missing stuck-exec validation nudge
- No warning for all-steps-done ∧ lifecycle=in-progress
- W-LC-TERMINAL (M145) only covers lifecycle=done + terminal triple

TERTIARY: (a) skill sharpness / deploy gap
- Stage 7 numbered but WRONG target state
- Stage 10 prose only; deep-dives not installed (SKILL.md only)

FIX PATH: Option A — align fiction to reality (minimal)
1. Skill/docs: complete → complete (actual); stage 10 must run reviews pass
2. W-LC-STUCK-EXEC: all steps done/skipped + lifecycle=in-progress → warn run complete
3. Do NOT restore M100 review ladder (Option B) — out of minimal scope; AC-02 reframed to terminal complete reliability

Evidence commands: mp show milestone 148; complete.rs:352; validate/plan.rs:549-586; reviews pass M145 promote only from done

findings.description: crates/mp/src/validate/plan.rs:570-578 (W-LC-STUCK-EXEC) fires on all steps closed ∧ lifecycle==in-progress with no check for open self-findings, but complete_milestone (complete.rs:301-314) bails when has_open_self_findings(). Stage-6 self-review state — all steps done, lifecycle in-progress, findings filed with --phase self, not yet resolved — is the common pre-complete window. In that state the warning says 'run mp milestone complete', but that command exits non-zero ('N open self-phase finding(s) remain'). This is the identical actionability trap M145 F-02 fixed for W-LC-TERMINAL (see plan.rs:590-595 rationale) — the same care was not applied to the sibling warning. Fix: when m.has_open_self_findings(), suppress W-LC-STUCK-EXEC or branch the message to 'resolve open self-findings (mp reviews finding resolve <id> --all), then run mp milestone complete'. Add test stuck_exec_message_when_open_self_findings.

findings.description: crates/mp/tests/transition_reliability.rs uses create_ready_with_step which adds exactly one step (S1). Four W-LC-STUCK-EXEC code branches are entirely uncovered: cancelled guard (plan.rs:554), steps.is_empty() guard (plan.rs:560), skipped counting as closed (plan.rs:566), and multi-step scenarios (3+ all-done; 2-done+1-pending). The 'all closed' fold is only tested on N=1. Tests to add: stuck_exec_silent_on_cancelled, stuck_exec_silent_when_no_steps, stuck_exec_fires_multi_step_all_done, stuck_exec_silent_multi_step_one_pending, stuck_exec_fires_with_skipped_step.
